text: Before the morning call to prayer, a wail of despair pierced the quiet mist of the compound.
The lock on the bridal hut had been slid back; the velvet cloth was crumpled on the earth floor, and the carved chest stood empty.
Word spread like wildfire through the compound.
The women stopped their pounding of coos; the men stood in uneasy silence by the bantaba.
Mai sat weeping upon her woven mat, while whispers began to circle Binta, who stood in the corner of the courtyard with eyes fixed firmly on the ground.
